Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 maintenance lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures; winter peak 530; cancellations 1.8%. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unresolved. Brake checks every 6,000 km. September 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4,200; second approval required above €200. Parts store: 1,100 line items; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim; two quotations required above €500.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminal on three routes. May 2026 double-published roster left two shifts uncovered; single named publisher required. Winter peak capacity next year unmodelled.
